_comment: SigNoz metric alert rules for rsync-ai (F-Obs-2). Each object is a separate alert created via SigNoz UI (Alerts -> New Alert -> PromQL) or the SigNoz alerts API (POST /api/v1/rules). Queries reference the domain metrics scraped by the otel-collector prometheus receiver. Tune targets to your traffic before enabling in prod. Token-expiry alerting is intentionally NOT here: no token-expiry gauge is emitted yet (tracked separately); these alerts cover only metrics the services actually export.

annotations.summary: Messages are being routed to a dead-letter queue
annotations.description: rsync_dlq_messages_total is increasing — data may be silently dropped. Inspect the DLQ topic and the healer replay status.

annotations.summary: api-gateway is returning 5xx for >5% of requests
annotations.description: Server-error ratio exceeded 5% for the evaluation window. Check api-gateway logs and downstream (orchestrator, DB) health.
Sustained auth failures (>5/s) — possible credential stuffing, or broken/expired tokens after a deploy. Correlate with recent releases.

annotations.summary: Sentinel healer is escalating to a human operator
annotations.description: rsync_healer_actions_total{outcome="escalated"} increased — automated recovery could not resolve a fault. Check the escalation reason in the healer logs.

annotations.summary: More than 20% of pipeline runs are failing
annotations.description: Failed-run ratio exceeded 20% over 30m. Inspect recent executions and connector health (rsync_mcp_calls_total{status="failure"}).
